premises.text: Wireless power must remotely, safely, and efficiently power multiple devices at a distance, including behind walls, with FCC approval
premises.evidence_span: How do you safely and efficiently power multiple devices and only those devices at a distance?

premises.text: KOTA uses a charger plus small receivers with beacon-guided path-focused power delivery (~1W at 30 feet) as safe as Wi-Fi
premises.evidence_span: A Kota-enabled receiver device would send out regularly a beacon signal that travels the environment and finds ways, paths, to the charger

premises.text: Works without line of sight; charger retargets continuously so power follows moving receivers
premises.evidence_span: Kota works without line of sight, powering devices behind walls and around corners without interfering with electronic equipment

premises.text: Ship as built-into devices/batteries and as dongles; partner with electronics OEMs (and interim industrial markets like oil/gas)
